AI compute infrastructure, Southeast Asia

We build and operate the infrastructure AI runs on.

The firm

Nourra Holdings is an AI compute infrastructure company headquartered in Singapore. We build and operate data centres designed for GPU clusters, with engineering and operations carried out by our own teams.

Business

  • Data centres

    High-density facilities in and around Singapore, providing space, power and cooling for GPU clusters.

  • Engineering

    Our own crews deliver electrical and low-voltage works, cabling, racking and facility conversion, and join larger projects as a specialist subcontractor.

  • Operations

    On-site teams run day-to-day operations, inspections and fault response, delivered against a service level agreement.

  • Compute

    Verified GPU capacity and enterprise cloud for our partners, deployed in our own facilities.

Footprint

Based in Singapore, working across Southeast Asia.

  • Singapore

    Headquarters, and home to our engineering and operations teams.

  • Malaysia

    A priority market, with data centre projects under way.

  • Indonesia

    A priority market, with data centre projects under way.

Principles

  • Our own teams

    The critical work is done by our own people. Responsibility stays in one place.

  • Compliance

    All business follows applicable export control and sanctions law. We confirm end user, location and use before we proceed.

  • Long-term partners

    We work with a limited number of partners over the long term, on written terms.

Contact

We work mainly through established relationships. For institutional partnerships and project discussions, write to us.
